hints.title: Hourglass Cell Offsets
hints.text: An hourglass with top-left corner at (r, c) spans 3 rows and 3 columns, covering 7 cells.

hints.title: Grid Bounds Iteration
hints.text: Iterate row index r from 0 to m - 3 and column index c from 0 to n - 3.

hints.title: Summation Formula
hints.text: Sum the 3 cells in row r, the center cell (r + 1, c + 1), and the 3 cells in row r + 2. Track the maximum total.

hints.title: Direct Hourglass Iteration Implementation

complexity.notes: Evaluates each 3x3 hourglass pattern in constant 7-addition steps.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Evaluating out of bounds indices or non-contiguous cells causes errors.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(1) memory operates in-place without buffers.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Iterates valid top-left anchor coordinates and calculates sum in O(1) per anchor.
